detail.cmpEpimer:
Epimers

D-Glucose and D-mannose differ in configuration at one carbon only, C-2. Two sugars like this are called epimers.
detail.cmpEnant:
Enantiomers

Every chiral carbon is reversed, so D-glucose and L-glucose are mirror images of each other. Enantiomers share one name and differ only in D or L.
